verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents running tmux inside Ghostty, and it offers no native tmux integration or control mode. The only tmux-related item is a community user wishing for tmux -CC (control mode) support, which suggests it is absent. General terminal-emulation and control-sequence docs are adjacent, not documentation of this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use tmux inside the terminal, or a documented native tmux integration/control mode
